A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same FreeCache and Guided Diffusion research, with v2 adding the FlashDLM name. Both complete 15-page documents, including equations, figures, tables and appendices, are readable and support comparison.

before.justification: Section 4 and Appendix B report original Dream and LLaDA accuracy, latency, guider comparisons, caching analyses and memory measurements.

after.justification: Section 4 and Appendix C retain original experiments and report revised GSM8K accuracies, additional comparison entries and a revised KV-stability analysis.

M1.justification: Section 3.2.1 changes the described FreeCache computation from forwarding the current block alone to recomputing a shrinking window containing the current and all subsequent blocks. v2 also removes the optional guided-correction procedure and Algorithm 2. These substantially revise the presented inference procedure and supported variants.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate MMLU-PRO, GSM8K, PiQA, ARC-C, ARC-E, GPQA and HellaSwag with the same task requirements. LLaDA evaluations already appear in v1 Appendix B; their increased main-text visibility does not introduce new dataset or task coverage.

E2.justification: The standalone GSM8K comparison changes substantially. v2 Table 4 adds Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct while retaining Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. It drops v1 Table 5's evaluated 3B-Instruct, base-7B, Math-7B variants, Llama3.1-8B-Instruct and 14B-Instruct baselines.

E3.justification: Figure 2 changes the diagnostic protocol from attention-block Spearman correlations against the initial state to token-position K/V similarities, described relative to the previous step. Benchmark prompts, hardware and numerical configuration settings remain unchanged in v1 Table 10 and v2 Table 11.

E4.justification: v1 Table 4's extensive guider-size, model-family, specialization and correction comparisons are replaced by a much narrower comparison. Figure 2 also replaces attention-block correlation analysis with direct K/V-stability heatmaps. The appendix's LLaDA block-size and Top-K analyses remain, as do the memory measurements.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests. The revised diagnostic similarity measurements do not introduce uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: Table 3 revises GSM8K accuracies from 83.77/82.33/83.21/83.69 to 79.68/77.40/80.33/81.41 for baseline, FreeCache and the two guided configurations, while retaining their latencies. v2 Table 4 adds small-AR and LLaDA Math-guider results, while extensive guider/correction results disappear. These are revised or newly reported outcomes, without evidence establishing same-setting performance changes.

T1.justification: v1 Equations 4–5, defining the prompt/generation partition of Q and K and expanding their attention product into four blocks, are removed along with the associated approximation argument. The preliminary unmasking equations and transformer-complexity table remain; no new theorem or proof appears.

C1.justification: The headline changes from up to 34× speedup to an average 12.14× for Dream, with the introduction additionally claiming 13.29× for LLaDA. The abstract qualifies accuracy preservation as negligible degradation. The central contributions of training-free caching and AR-guided unmasking remain.

C2.justification: The caching rationale now emphasizes direct temporal stability of K/V projections. Sections 4.2 and 5 newly acknowledge weaker DLM reasoning than strong AR models, approximation errors, memory costs, guider complexity and alignment dependence. These replace the earlier conclusion's emphasis on future extension beyond Dream.

D1.justification: v1 promises a future code release; v2 supplies repository links in the abstract and Appendix B.1 and states that implementation is available. Checkpoint names become more specific, including Instruct and Dream-v0 labels. Hardware, numerical hyperparameters and prompt templates are retained.

R1.justification: The same 27 cited works remain. Sections 2.3 and 3.2.2 sharpen the distinction between prior speculative diffusion using a small diffusion drafter and the proposed large-DLM/small-AR guidance arrangement. This is a limited positioning refinement rather than a literature expansion.

P1.justification: v2 adds FlashDLM to the title, rewrites selected caching and comparison passages, adds a main-text memory subsection and an LLM-usage appendix, and renumbers the supplementary sections. Most prose and the overall introduction–related work–method–experiments structure remain.

P2.justification: v2 removes the introductory comparison table, replaces Figure 2's four line plots with two heatmaps, annotates Figure 1b and reformats Algorithm 1 while removing Algorithm 2. The broad guider tables become a compact cross-model table; new main-text caching and memory tables redisplay selected results. These substantially restructure the visual presentation.

improvement.justification: v2 provides more explicit cache-window instructions, direct KV-stability evidence, substantive limitations and code-access information. However, it removes broad guider/correction evidence and revises GSM8K accuracies without explaining their provenance or connecting the revised caching procedure to retained timings. These competing changes prevent a reliable net quality judgment; most apparent LLaDA and memory additions already existed in v1's appendix.
